recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not copy the retired Sequence wording into MolecularDefinition; if ambiguity remains in current MolecularDefinition sequence, allele, or variation profiles, handle it as a new MolecularDefinition-specific Clinical Genomics issue.
issue_request: FHIR-11314 was a Published Clinical Genomics change request for FHIR-core-Sequence asking to clarify Sequence.variant.observedAllele, Sequence.observedSeq, read coverage, and Sequence.repository. The final resolution clarified that observedAllele is scoped to variant.start through variant.end, observedSeq is scoped to referenceSeq.windowStart through referenceSeq.windowEnd, and repository points to an external repository containing the observedSeq report.
initial_application: The historical application was commit d5ba8fdc2448787bf21f9411357e3a0780a7f039, which edited source/sequence/sequence-spreadsheet.xml to add the requested observedAllele range wording and observedSeq/referenceSeq window wording.
additional_context: Sequence was later renamed to MolecularSequence, and current source/fhir.ini lists Sequence under removed resources while molecularsequence entries are commented out. FHIR-51227 is an Applied R6 decision replacing legacy MolecularSequence with MolecularDefinition; MolecularDefinition uses a different representation model rather than the old observedSeq/repository elements.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the old clarification was applied historically and the current source no longer exposes the affected Sequence elements.
